---

**Shot Types (Dental/Medical)**

**Headshots**
- One shot per staff member (name + title listed individually on the shot list)
- Options: cut-out on white background, white backdrop, or medium gray backdrop
- Used for: website staff page, LinkedIn, social media, business cards

**Office/Building Photos — Standard Shot List**
- External office (sign/logo board or full building)
- Waiting room
- Front desk with smiling receptionist
- Front desk without receptionist
- Hallway (if applicable)
- Consultation room(s)
- Exam room(s)
- Highlighted machines (X-ray, CEREC, etc.)
- Detailed tools
- Personal/decorative details (art, personal photos, misc. elements)
- Dentist and patient socializing/working
- Dentist and staff socializing/working
- Staff socializing and/or working

**Product Shots** (separate category, only if applicable)

---

**How Many Photos**

There's no fixed number baked into the template. The volume is determined by the hours sold in the service agreement (e.g., "3-hour shoot with 9 hours of edits"). For website use, the discovery doc shows an example like Home - 5, Cosmetic Dentistry - 2, Teeth Whitening - 2 — broken out by page.

**Other Details**
- $250 rescheduling fee if rescheduled within 7 days of the shoot
- HIPAA release required if patients are featured
- Call sheet sent to client 24 hours before the shoot
- Photos edited and uploaded to Dropbox, reviewed by Creative Manager, then sent to client
